description: Bootstrap brain lessons from git history. Parses commit messages and infers fix/feature/refactor lessons automatically. Great for onboarding an existing codebase — run once and the brain instantly knows your team's accumulated patterns. Incremental by default: only processes new commits since the last run, so repeated calls are fast. Emits progress updates to stderr during long scans.

branch.description: Git branch to parse (default: current branch / HEAD)

incremental.description: Only process commits since last run (default: true). Set false to reprocess all.

repo_path.description: Path to git repository (default: current directory)

since.description: Only commits after this date, e.g. "2024-01-01" (optional)

name: brain_from_git
